name: Thia Aide AI Content Creator
author: thiaide

sections.description:
Thia Aide AI Content Creator helps you generate high-quality content for your WordPress site using artificial intelligence. Perfect for WooCommerce product descriptions, blog posts, and more.

Features

  • AI-Powered Content Generation – Generate unique product descriptions with one click
  • Grammar Check – Fix grammar and spelling errors in your content
  • Text Formatting – Automatically format text with proper HTML tags
  • Readability Improvement – Enhance text flow and sentence structure
  • Translation – Translate content to multiple languages
  • Multi-Language Support – Supports Bulgarian, English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Turkish, Greek, Romanian, Polish, Czech, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, and Finnish
  • WooCommerce Integration – Works seamlessly with WooCommerce products
  • WordPress Posts Support – Use AI tools in post editor
  • API Statistics Dashboard – Track API usage, calls, and success rates
  • Easy API Key Setup – Simple configuration interface

External services

This plugin connects to the Thia Aide API (https://thiaide.com/api/) to generate and process content.

It sends the following data to the API when:
– Generating product descriptions from titles
– Fixing grammar and spelling in content
– Formatting text with HTML
– Improving text readability
– Translating content to another language

Data sent to the API:
– Content text (product title, description, or post content)
– Selected language preference
– API key for authentication

This service is provided by Thia Aide:
– Terms of Use: https://www.thiaide.com/terms-of-use/
– Privacy Policy: https://www.thiaide.com/privacy-policy/

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Get your API key from thiaide.com
  3. Enter your API key in Thia Creator > Settings
  4. Choose your preferred content language
  5. Start generating content from the WordPress editor

Privacy

This plugin connects to the Thia Aide API service at thiaide.com to generate content. Your API key and content are transmitted securely over HTTPS. No user data is collected or stored beyond what is necessary for content generation.

Credits

Developed by Thia Aide

Support

For support, please visit thiaide.com or use the WordPress.org support forums.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “Thia Aide AI Content Creator”
  3. Click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the zip file and click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin

Configuration

  1. After activation, go to Thia Creator in your admin menu
  2. Enter your API key from thiaide.com
  3. Select your preferred content language
  4. Start creating content!
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key?

Yes, you need an API key from thiaide.com to use the AI features. You can get one by registering at thiaide.com.

What languages are supported?

The plugin supports: Bulgarian, English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Turkish, Greek, Romanian, Polish, Czech, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, and Finnish.

Does this work with WooCommerce?

Yes, the plugin integrates directly with WooCommerce product editor, adding AI buttons for product descriptions.

Is my content secure?

Yes, all communication with the Thia Aide API is encrypted over HTTPS. Your API key and content are transmitted securely.

Where can I see my API usage?

The plugin includes a statistics dashboard showing daily, monthly, and all-time API calls and success rates.
